messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize the design partner recruitment & qualification matrix for the Q2 beta. Can we lock criteria today? @Jordan @Lee

Jordan (Design): I can do a condensed scoring rubric. We should prioritize teams with production traffic and privacy needs. +1 for on-prem interest. :white_check_mark:

Lee (Eng): Need to confirm infra constraints — how many concurrent sessions can Dedicated handle in beta? I'll pull numbers but for recruiting we should cap early.

Priya (Research): Suggest 6-week feedback loop cadence, weekly check-ins first 2 weeks. Will own surveys and usage prompts.

Carlos (Sales): Incentives: 6 months free Dedicated? risky. Maybe $3k credit or co-marketing for case studies. Also capture ARR potential.

Emma (Solutions): For onboarding, require an internal owner, network contact, and data classification. We should include a short screen form. Here's a draft:

```
Name:
Org:
Primary use-case:
Estimated monthly tokens:
Compliance (yes/no):
Private deployment? (yes/no)
Accept NDA? (yes/no)
Customer success contact:
```

Jordan (Design): Add 'willingness to run experiment flags' to measure feature adoption.

Maya (PM): Launch criteria proposal: 5 committed partners across industries, average weekly active users >= 10 per partner, no critical data leak incidents, baseline latency within 2x prod for 90p.

Lee (Eng): Also add rollback plan: toggle to hosted fallback; require canary for model rollouts.

Priya (Research): Success metrics: qualitative NPS >= 6/10, reduction in support tickets over time, actioned feedback items >= 8.

Carlos (Sales): Recruitment window: open for 3 weeks, aim for 15 applicants to select 6. I'll target enterprise trial list + PLG users.

Emma (Solutions): Onboarding checklist: SSO, KMS, networking, sample prompt set, ops playbook. We need <72h SLA for infra setup for beta partners.

Maya (PM): Agree. Action items: Jordan draft scoring matrix by EOD, Priya prep survey, Lee estimate capacity + canary plan, Carlos reach out to shortlist. I'll assemble final invite. :rocket:

Jordan (Design): On it. Will post rubric in #product by 4pm.

Lee (Eng): I'll post concurrency numbers and a quick `docker-compose` snippet if we need local validation.

Priya (Research): I'll schedule kickoff interviews with each partner in week 0.

Carlos (Sales): Pinging @Emma for case study template once partner signs.

Emma (Solutions): got it.
